description: This bar chart illustrates the Bias Percentage across three distinct categories under various contact conditions, comparing data from before and after an event. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are ordered from left to right as "Sports", an obscured category where the label is covered by a solid gray rectangle, and "Healthcare". The vertical axis represents the "Bias Percentage" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 10. The chart utilizes a grouped and stacked bar format. Within each horizontal category, there is a cluster of three stacked bars. Based on the legend positioned below the chart, the left bar in each cluster represents "No Contact", the middle bar represents "Positive Contact", and the right bar represents "Negative Contact". Each of these bars is stacked into two segments: a solid-colored bottom segment representing the "Before" condition, and a hatched-pattern top segment representing the "After" condition. Specifically, "No Contact Before" is solid light gray, "No Contact After" is hatched dark gray; "Positive Contact Before" is solid light red, "Positive Contact After" is hatched dark red; and "Negative Contact Before" is solid light blue, "Negative Contact After" is hatched dark blue. Every data point is explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value; the "Before" values are printed in regular text inside the solid bottom segments, while the "After" values are printed in bold text directly above the top of each stacked bar. In the "Sports" category, the bars are the tallest overall, with "Before" values of 45.42 (No Contact), 43.65 (Positive Contact), and 50.05 (Negative Contact), and corresponding "After" values of 7.45, 8.31, and 8.33. In the obscured middle category, the "Before" values are 38.08, 35.38, and 40.79, with very low "After" values of 0.00, 0.01, and 0.00, resulting in no visible hatched top segments for the zero values. Similarly, in the "Healthcare" category, the "Before" values are 40.70, 37.51, and 46.73, with "After" values of 0.00, 0.01, and 0.11. The categories and bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order based on their total values.
